name: mission-control-interstellar-for-copilot-cowork
author: Shervin Shaffie
audience: Public - Microsoft 365 work accounts with Copilot Cowork and App Builder
platform: Microsoft Copilot Managed Runtime (Copilot App Builder); runs in any modern browser
description: A Microsoft 365 dashboard installed with Copilot Cowork: today's priorities, calendar, mail, Teams, files, OneNote, To Do and Planner on one screen, plus two-way GitHub, Google Drive, Google Calendar and Box panels and a combined Outlook + Google calendar with overlap highlighting. Runs without per-use AI.

requires.runLicense: Power Apps Premium, or Copilot Credits (pay as you go)
requires.installWith: Copilot Cowork with App Builder (Microsoft Copilot license + Copilot Credits; tenant in the Frontier program)
requires.microsoft365Copilot: optional (improves the Draft with Copilot hand-off)

costModel: No per-use AI at runtime. Rules run in the app; deeper questions hand off to the user's own Microsoft 365 Copilot. Data loads on open, Refresh, or when you open something.

storage.activityHistory: the user's own OneDrive: /Mission Control Interstellar/Activity history.json

privacy: Contains none of the author's (or anyone else's) personal data or organization identifiers. Enforced by scripts/verify-clean.mjs, which fails on any email address, GUID, connection ID or tenant-specific URL. Each person connects their own accounts; connections are not shareable.
note: Not an official Microsoft product. Author attribution is provenance metadata and is not shown in the app UI.
